name: lean-search
description: A lean, fast Obsidian search that always surfaces the note you want, favoring recently-opened notes (frecency) like zoxide.

scripts.test: esbuild test/smoke.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/.smoke.bundle.mjs && node test/.smoke.bundle.mjs && esbuild test/index-cache.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:obsidian=./test/obsidian-shim.mjs --outfile=test/.cache.bundle.mjs && node test/.cache.bundle.mjs && rm -f test/.smoke.bundle.mjs test/.cache.bundle.mjs
scripts.bench: esbuild test/perf.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:obsidian=./test/obsidian-shim.mjs --outfile=test/.perf.bundle.mjs && node test/.perf.bundle.mjs && rm -f test/.perf.bundle.mjs
